' ---- [modInventory.AddProduct] Sub AddProduct (analysis: Mock summary.) ----
Public Sub AddProduct(ByVal sku As String, ByVal productName As String, ByVal category As String, ByVal unitPrice As Double, ByVal stock As Long, ByVal reorderLevel As Long)

    Dim nextRow As Long
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products")

' ---- [modInventory.PlaceOrder] Function PlaceOrder (analysis: Mock summary.) ----
Public Function PlaceOrder(ByVal sku As String, ByVal qty As Long) As Boolean
    Dim products As Worksheet
    Dim orders As Worksheet
    Dim prodRow As Long
    Dim orderRow As Long
    Set products = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products")
    Set orders = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Orders")
    If Not IsValidQty(qty) Then
        MsgBox "Quantity must be between 1 and 1000."
        PlaceOrder = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    prodRow = FindProductRow(sku)
    If prodRow = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Unknown product: " & sku
        PlaceOrder = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If products.Cells(prodRow, 5).Value < qty Then
        MsgBox "Not enough stock for " & sku
        PlaceOrder = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    orderRow = orders.Cells(orders.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).row + 1
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 1).Value = "ORD-" & Format(orderRow - 1, "0000")
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 2).Value = Date
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 3).Value = sku
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 4).Value = qty
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 5).Value = CalcOrderTotal(products.Cells(prodRow, 4).Value, qty)
    orders.Cells(orderRow, 6).Value = "Open"
    products.Cells(prodRow, 5).Value = products.Cells(prodRow, 5).Value - qty
    CheckReorder sku
    PlaceOrder = True
End Function

' ---- [modInventory.CheckReorder] Sub CheckReorder (analysis: Mock summary.) ----
Public Sub CheckReorder(ByVal sku As String)
    Dim r As Long
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products")
    r = FindProductRow(sku)
    If r = 0 Then Exit Sub
    If ws.Cells(r, 5).Value <= ws.Cells(r, 6).Value Then
        MsgBox "Stock for " & ws.Cells(r, 2).Value & " is low. Please reorder."
    End If
End Sub

' ---- [modInventory.RefreshStockStatus] Sub RefreshStockStatus (analysis: Mock summary.) ----
Public Sub RefreshStockStatus()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products")
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).row
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If ws.Cells(i, 5).Value <= ws.Cells(i, 6).Value Then
            ws.Cells(i, 7).Value = LOW_STOCK_LABEL
        Else
            ws.Cells(i, 7).Value = OK_STOCK_LABEL
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

' ---- [modInventory.ExportLowStockCSV] Sub ExportLowStockCSV (analysis: Mock summary.) ----
Public Sub ExportLowStockCSV()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim filePath As String
    Dim fileNum As Integer
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Products")
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).row
    filePath = ThisWorkbook.Path & Application.PathSeparator & "low_stock.csv"
    fileNum = FreeFile
    Open filePath For Output As #fileNum
    Print #fileNum, "SKU,Name,Stock,ReorderLevel"
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If ws.Cells(i, 7).Value = LOW_STOCK_LABEL Then
            Print #fileNum, ws.Cells(i, 1).Value & "," & ws.Cells(i, 2).Value & "," & ws.Cells(i, 5).Value & "," & ws.Cells(i, 6).Value
        End If
    Next i
    Close #fileNum
    MsgBox "Exported to " & filePath
End Sub
